query:
SELECT 
  SUM(CAST(custo AS DECIMAL(15,2))) as total_custo,
  COUNT(*) as qtd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN equipamentoTag = 'OUTROS' THEN CAST(custo AS DECIMAL(15,2)) ELSE 0 END) as total_outros
FROM item_despesa_importado 
WHERE periodoCustoId = (SELECT id FROM periodo_custo WHERE mes = 5 AND ano = 2026 LIMIT 1);
